description: This PHP source file defines the `DatabaseConnectionWrapper` class, which encapsulates a database connection and handles error detection, messaging, and connection establishment logic within the OrangeHRM installation process. It manages connection errors, provides error messages, and attempts to establish database connections with PDO extensions.

classes.name: DatabaseConnectionWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing database connections and related errors during the installation process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection and exception objects.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if there was an error with the connection.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a descriptive error message based on the exception type and error code.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the stored Throwable object representing the error.

methods.name: establishConnection
methods.description: Static method that attempts to establish a database connection using a provided callback, while checking for required PHP extensions.
